nodes.description: Private owner address stored in Ownable (_owner); controls privileged functions.
Private address newComer initialised at deployment to _msgSender(); used by onlyOwner modifier as the effective owner check.
Mapping address => uint256 of token balances (_balances), mutated in _transfer.
Nested mapping of allowances (_allowances), mutated in _approve and read in transferFrom/allowance.
Total token supply _tTotal = 10*10**9*10**18, minted to deployer in constructor.
Token name string _name = ' Secret Meme Coin '.
Token symbol string _symbol = 'SMC'.
Token decimals uint8 _decimals = 18.
Context._msgSender() returns msg.sender as address payable.
onlyOwner modifier requiring newComer == _msgSender(); the actual access-control gate for privileged functions.
_approve(address ol, address tt, uint256 amount): if ol != owner() forces allowance to 0, otherwise sets amount; core of approval logic.
External approve(spender, amount) calls _approve(_msgSender(), spender, amount).
External transferFrom(sender, recipient, amount) performs _transfer then deducts allowance via _approve.
External transfer(recipient, amount) calls _transfer(_msgSender(), recipient, amount).
Internal _transfer(sender, recipient, amount) updates _balances with SafeMath add/sub and emits Transfer.
owner() view returns _owner.
renounceOwnership() onlyOwner sets _owner to address(0).
transferOwnership(newOwner) onlyOwner transfers ownership, requires non-zero address.
allowance(owner, spender) view returns _allowances[owner][spender].
balanceOf(account) view returns _balances[account].
totalSupply() view returns _tTotal.
msg.sender, attacker-controlled caller address used throughout for authorization and transfers.
In _approve: if (ol != owner()) _allowances[ol][tt] = 0; silently zeroes/ignores approvals for any non-owner caller (honeypot-style locked allowance).
Address.sendValue performs recipient.call{value: amount}("") low-level ETH transfer enabling reentrancy before/after state updates.
Address._functionCallWithValue performs target.call{value: weiValue}(data) external low-level call, reentrancy-capable.
Arithmetic on _balances using SafeMath sub/add in _transfer (amount deductions/additions).
Parameter ol (address) of _approve, the allowance owner.
Parameter tt (address) of _approve, the spender.
Parameter amount (uint256) of _approve.
Parameter spender (address) of approve.
Parameter amount (uint256) of public approve.
Parameter sender (address) of transferFrom.
Parameter recipient (address) of transferFrom.
Parameter amount (uint256) of transferFrom.
Parameter recipient (address) of transfer.
Parameter amount (uint256) of transfer.
Parameter sender (address) of internal _transfer.
Parameter recipient (address) of internal _transfer.
Parameter amount (uint256) of internal _transfer.
Local address msgSender = _msgSender() in Ownable constructor, assigned to _owner and newComer.
